name: TaxiDriver
author: Dominik
description: Taxi service controlled only through the in-game phone. CALL TAXI uses SpikeCommands.CallTaxi -> SpikeRunner.TickAutoRun to spawn a TaxiDriver-owned vehicle at the stand, board the registered taxi_driver, then navigate to the player. The app retains destination selection, search, filters, live ride status, fare display, and STOP. Vanilla E entry/exit and Escape phone-close remain unchanged. TaxiDriver installs no keyboard bindings. The taxi.glb visual is loaded through S1MAPI.Gltf.GltfLoader only when a usable renderer is present; failed imports leave vanilla visuals visible. Matched imported wheel nodes roll from native point velocity and steer from native wheel angles, visual-only with no suspension transfer; native visual acceptance remains open. Destruction is restricted to the exact TaxiDriver-owned vehicle; uncertain destruction retains the tracked state. Passenger rides fail closed unless all required protection patches are installed. Fares are bounded and an uncertain payment result is not retried. A private scoped traffic-light flag bypass applies only to the owned autonomous physical taxi; generic obstacles and destination braking remain native. Explicit traffic-only waits protect recovery clocks; kinematic/unknown driving retains vanilla. The prior 0.8.21 red-light behavior is owner-confirmed. Driver controller repair uses existing owner/network-registered patrol only, otherwise existing direct navigation; no runtime networking components. Pending native release retains original state and blocks replacement/recovery. Permanent invalid ownership can require scene reload. Owner-confirmed finished 2026-10-24; known road/jitter issues remain and multiplayer was not separately tested. Current target: Schedule I 0.4.7f12, installed S1API 3.2.1 stable, and S1MAPI 2.0.1; build and gameplay evidence are in docs/compatibility.md.
